top_jobs.job: When it is Sunday night and the Monday meeting is at 9, help me see what happened last week, why, and the 3 calls I need to make, so I walk in ready instead of up late in 6 tabs
top_jobs.metric: minutes the founder spends preparing the weekly meeting, and decisions logged from it, weekly

top_jobs.job: When sales look good or a platform claims big numbers, help me see the profit left after every cost and one agreed number per metric, so I do not celebrate a week that lost money
top_jobs.metric: profit after product cost, shipping, discounts, returns and ad spend, weekly

top_jobs.job: When a client, a partner, an investor or a lender asks how it went, help me send a clear answer with the numbers, the reasons and the plan, so they trust us and stay
top_jobs.metric: days from month or quarter end to report sent, and replies asking why

top_jobs.job: When I run an agency with 8 brands and 1 hour to spare, help me see which 2 brands need me this week and who on the team is stretched, so I act before a client slips
top_jobs.metric: brands with a key number outside its normal range for 2 or more weeks, and days until someone acted

top_jobs.job: When the month closes, help me see what each change moved, what we paid for and where we stand against plan, so next month's money goes where it earned the most
top_jobs.metric: gross profit banked from changes rolled out this month, and sales and profit after ads against plan

jobs.job: Build the Monday pack each Sunday at 6 pm: 6 numbers with last week, the 4 week average and the normal range, the 3 biggest movers with a named cause, and 3 calls to make
jobs.trigger: every Sunday at 6 pm

inputs.need: the 6 numbers the founder cares about

steps: Pull last week's data from each connected account
Compute the 6 numbers in code, marking any missing source as unavailable
Compare each with its 4 week average and normal range
Pick the 3 biggest movers and name a cause for each with the evidence
Write 3 calls with a suggested owner
Founder reads it in 10 minutes and edits the calls
jobs.output: a 1 page Monday pack: 6 numbers, 3 movers with causes, 3 calls

watch.metric: minutes the founder spends preparing the weekly meeting

jobs.job: Flag any key number outside its normal range for 2 weeks running, with the start date and the likely cause checked against stock, price, ads, site changes and season, and send only these while the founder is away
jobs.trigger: daily check, sent in the Monday pack, and as the only alerts while the founder is away

inputs.from: store platform, GA4, Meta Ads and Google Ads

inputs.need: site changes, price changes and launches with dates

steps: Set a normal range for each key number from the last 12 weeks, season adjusted
Mark any number outside it for 2 weeks running
Check the causes in order: stock, price, ad changes, site changes, season, tracking
Name the most likely cause with the evidence
Send the flag to the number's owner, or to the founder if it is an emergency
jobs.output: a short list of numbers off for 2 weeks, each with a start date, a cause and an owner
jobs.next: feeds 26-01 (Monday pack) and 26-15 (brands needing the lead)

watch.metric: key numbers outside their normal range for 2 or more weeks

jobs.job: Add a 'shipped and what it did' section from the work board: cards moved to live and measured last week, each with its metric before and after
jobs.trigger: every Sunday with the pack

inputs.need: cards moved to live or measured, with owner and metric
the metric before and after each change
inputs.from: store platform, GA4 and ad accounts

steps: Pull cards that moved to live or measured last week
Pull each card's metric for 14 days before and since
Mark each as moved, flat or too early
List late cards with the owner
jobs.output: a shipped list: each change, owner, metric before and after, and late cards

watch.metric: share of shipped cards with a before and after number

jobs.drives: work that moves numbers, not just gets done

jobs.job: Put service next to money every week: first reply time, time to resolution, follow-ups owed, open backlog and the 30 day review rating, with the order value in open tickets
jobs.trigger: every Sunday with the pack

inputs.need: tickets with reply, resolution and follow-up times

steps: Pull the week's ticket times and backlog
Count follow-ups owed over 48 hours and the order value at stake
Add the 30 day review rating and the top new complaint
Flag service slipping while sales hold
jobs.output: a service block in the Monday pack with red flags and dollars at stake

watch.metric: first reply time in hours and open ticket backlog

jobs.job: List tests due, ended and waiting on a call in the pack, decide each in the meeting, then send the team a 5 line note of what moved and what was decided, with owner and date
jobs.trigger: every Monday
steps: Add due and ended tests with the read to the pack
Decide each in the meeting
Write the 5 line note: 3 numbers that moved, the calls, owners and dates
Log each call on the decisions shelf and the board
Count opens of the note
jobs.output: test calls made in the meeting, and a team note with owners and dates

watch.metric: test reads decided in the weekly meeting

jobs.drives: decisions per week and time to act

jobs.job: Write the weekly profit line: sales minus product cost, shipping, payment fees, discounts, returns and ad spend, with any cost marked unavailable when its source is missing
jobs.trigger: every Monday, and at month close

inputs.need: orders with discounts, shipping charged and refunds
shipping and fulfilment cost per order

steps: Pull sales and each cost line for the week
Compute profit after ads in code
Mark any missing line unavailable, not 0
Compare with last week and the plan
Write one line: the week made or lost $X after ads
jobs.output: a weekly profit line with every cost named and gaps marked

watch.metric: profit after product cost, shipping, discounts, returns and ad spend

jobs.job: Set platform-claimed purchases from Meta, Google and the agency next to store orders by channel for the same window, and show the gap in dollars and percent
jobs.trigger: every Monday and at month close

inputs.need: purchases and value claimed per platform
store orders by source and UTM

steps: Pull claimed purchases per platform for the window
Pull store orders by channel for the same dates
Show claimed against store orders and the gap
Mark where the claims add up to more than total store orders
Use store orders for budget calls
jobs.output: a claimed against real table per channel with the gap

watch.metric: gap between orders a platform claims and store orders from that channel

jobs.job: Write one agreed source for each report number in the number book (store for sales, GA4 for sessions, ad accounts for spend) and flag any conflict over 5 percent
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then when a source changes

inputs.need: the same number from store, GA4 and ad accounts
numbers not to trust and why

steps: List the 20 numbers used in reports
Pick one source and one formula for each
Compare each across sources for the last 4 weeks
Flag conflicts over 5 percent with the likely reason
Founder signs the book
jobs.output: a number book: 20 numbers, 1 source and formula each, and open conflicts

watch.metric: report numbers with a missing or conflicting source

jobs.drives: meetings spent on decisions, not data

jobs.job: Split weekly revenue into new and returning customers, and show sales after returns, refunds and chargebacks next to booked sales
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.need: orders with customer first order date

steps: Tag each order new or returning
Sum revenue by group for the week
Subtract returns, refunds and chargebacks by week of order
Show booked and kept sales side by side
jobs.output: a weekly table: new, returning, booked and kept sales

watch.metric: new customer orders and returning customer orders

jobs.drives: growth that comes from new buyers

jobs.job: Rank products by profit after discounts, shipping and returns each month, and flag top sellers with ad spend up and under 21 days of stock
jobs.trigger: monthly for the rank; weekly for the stock flag

inputs.need: orders, discounts and returns per product
stock and sell rate per product

steps: Compute profit per product after discounts, shipping and returns
Rank and compare with the sales rank
Compute days of stock at the current sell rate
Flag products with ad spend up and under 21 days of stock
Send the flags to the ad owner
jobs.output: a product profit rank and a stock against ad spend flag list

watch.metric: days of stock left on the top 10 sellers next to their ad spend

jobs.job: Draft the monthly client report from the packs: what happened, why, what we changed, what it did, and next month's plan, with unavailable numbers named and never shown as 0
jobs.trigger: on the 2nd working day of each month
steps: Pull the month's numbers against last month and last year
Write what happened and why, in 5 lines
List changes and what each moved
Write next month's plan with 3 priorities
Account lead edits and sends
jobs.output: a 2 page client report sent by the 3rd working day

watch.metric: days from month end to report sent

jobs.job: Add a creative section to the monthly report: spend share by awareness level against last month, the top 3 ads with why they won, and 1 postmortem with the fix
jobs.trigger: monthly with the client report

inputs.need: ads with spend and awareness tags
ad results with age, gender and placement
the month's worst ad with its postmortem

steps: Show spend share per awareness level this month and last
Name the top 3 ads and the principle behind each
Add 1 postmortem: what failed, where people dropped, the fix
Say what top of funnel ads come next month
jobs.output: a 1 page creative section: awareness mix, 3 winners, 1 postmortem

watch.metric: share of spend on unaware and problem aware ads

jobs.job: Draft the quarterly investor or lender update from real numbers: sales, gross profit, cash against the bank, what went well, what did not, and the ask
jobs.trigger: 5 working days after quarter end, and on any lender request
steps: Pull the quarter's numbers and tie sales to payouts
Write 3 wins, 3 misses, and the plan
Check every number against its source
Founder edits and sends
jobs.output: an investor or lender update that ties to the bank

watch.metric: days from quarter end to update sent

jobs.job: Answer 'is it us or the market?' with the brand's sales change next to category search demand change for the same weeks, with sale and holiday dates marked
jobs.trigger: monthly, and when a client asks

inputs.need: weekly sales, this year and last

inputs.from: Search Console and search trend data

inputs.need: sale and holiday dates both years

steps: Pull weekly sales for both years
Pull category search demand for the same weeks
Line up sale and holiday dates
Write one line: we moved X, the category moved Y
jobs.output: a chart of brand against category, with the calendar marked, and one line

watch.metric: brand sales change against category search demand change

jobs.job: Rank all client brands each Monday by key numbers out of range for 2 weeks and days since someone acted, and pick the 2 that need the lead this week
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.from: store platform and ad accounts per brand

steps: Pull the out of range flags for every brand
Add days since the last action on each flag
Score and rank the brands
Name the 2 that need the lead and why
Book the time on the board
jobs.output: a ranked brand list with the 2 picks and the reason

watch.metric: brands with a key number off for 2 or more weeks, and days until someone acted

jobs.job: Show each account manager's booked hours across all brands against their available hours, and move work from anyone booked over 100 percent
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.need: hours booked per person per brand

steps: Pull booked hours per person for the week
Compare with available hours
Flag anyone over 100 percent
Move 1 brand task or a report to someone under 80 percent
jobs.output: a load table per account manager with moves made

watch.metric: people booked over 100 percent of available hours

jobs.drives: clients dropped by a stretched manager

jobs.job: Show hours spent on each brand next to its monthly fee, and list brands where the fee covers less than the cost of the hours
jobs.trigger: monthly
steps: Sum hours per brand
Cost them at each role's hourly cost
Compare with the fee
List brands under water and write fix, reprice or drop
jobs.output: a brand margin table with a call per brand

watch.metric: hours booked per brand against the fee

jobs.job: Match each agency and freelancer invoice line to delivered work on the board and to the contract, and list the dollars with no matching delivery
jobs.trigger: when each invoice arrives
steps: Load invoice lines
Match each to delivered cards
List unmatched dollars and missed scope
Send questions before paying
jobs.output: an invoice check with unmatched dollars and a 3 month delivery pattern

watch.metric: invoice dollars with no matching delivered work

jobs.drives: cash paid for work not done

jobs.job: Before next month's budget is set, show where the last dollar earned the most on each channel last month, and propose the split on results
jobs.trigger: the last week of each month

inputs.need: spend and store orders per channel and campaign
inputs.from: Meta Ads, Google Ads and store platform

steps: Compute profit after ads per channel
Compare the last 20 percent of spend on each channel with its average
Propose the split within the caps
Founder approves; log the split
jobs.output: a proposed budget split with the reason per channel

watch.metric: each channel's share of spend against the agreed split

jobs.job: At month close, list every change rolled out (tests, new ads, site changes, offers) and the gross profit each moved, next to sales, spend and profit against plan
jobs.trigger: on the 2nd working day of each month
steps: List changes shipped this month
Pull what each moved and mark proven, likely or unknown
Show sales, spend and profit after ads against plan
Name the gap and the 2 moves that close it
jobs.output: a month close page: changes and their money, plan against actual, the gap

watch.metric: gross profit banked from changes rolled out this month

jobs.drives: fees and team time judged on results

new_enablers.name: Number book
new_enablers.what: One agreed source, formula, window and unavailable rule for every number in a report. Flags conflicts between sources and shows platform claims next to store orders.

new_enablers.name: Mover explainer
new_enablers.what: Sets a normal range for each key number, flags any number off for 2 weeks, and checks causes in order: stock, price, ads, site changes, season, tracking. Works across brands for an agency.

new_enablers.name: Review pack builder
new_enablers.what: Builds the Monday pack, the monthly client report, the month close and the investor update from the same numbers, with shipped work, tests due and service next to money.
powers: investor updates that tie to the bank
